paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space
caption: figure
model_annotation: The bar chart, titled "Quality Scores," compares two sets of scores—labeled as AVG<sub>obj</sub> (light blue bars) and AVG<sub>sub</sub> (light orange bars)—across three categories on the horizontal axis: IFD, TagNum, and DEITA. The vertical axis, labeled "Scores," ranges from 30 to 70 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. For each category, the AVG<sub>obj</sub> score is consistently higher than the AVG<sub>sub</sub> score: IFD shows 63.98 (AVG<sub>obj</sub>) and 41.90 (AVG<sub>sub</sub>); TagNum shows 66.06 (AVG<sub>obj</sub>) and 39.13 (AVG<sub>sub</sub>); DEITA shows 67.64 (AVG<sub>obj</sub>) and 42.99 (AVG<sub>sub</sub>). A dashed blue horizontal line at approximately 65.00 represents the Base Avg<sub>obj</sub>, while a dashed yellow line at approximately 38.00 represents the Base Avg<sub>sub</sub>. The legend in the upper right corner identifies the line styles and colors for each metric. The bars are grouped by category and arranged in the order IFD, TagNum, DEITA from left to right, with no sorting by value. All bars are of uniform width and are visually distinct by color, with no additional emphasis or annotations beyond the numerical values displayed above each bar.
